newsitem.title: USA: US CORPORATE BONDS- Another heavy day of issuance.
newsitem.headline: US CORPORATE BONDS- Another heavy day of issuance.

text.p: Another $2.7 billion in new straight corporate high-grade debt was dumped on the market on Tuesday as issuers continued to capitalize on attractive interest rates, players said.
"Everyone's focused on the new issues coming to market," said one high-grade trader. "These new issues have gotten everyone involved."
The busy pace in the primary sector spilled into the secondary trading arena with players seeing good two-way flow and spreads seen a touch tighter.
